pages.title: Premium Rations
pages.text: $(bold)Field rations coated in Blaze extract.$()$(br2)Stays hot indefinitely. Tastes like regret and capsaicin. ORSA Nutritional Services rates it "technically edible."$(br2)Hot Wings are one of the few foods that never frost over in your inventory, which makes them excellent for stockpiling before the Nether severs in Phase 5.

pages.title: Supply Notes
pages.text: Cooked chicken gives you the meal. Blaze powder gives you the part that alarms doctors. The result is a premium ration that restores serious hunger without replacing every other food source in the game.$(br2)Make them early, make them sparingly, and maybe keep water nearby.
One cooked chicken, one pinch of Nether bad decisions.
